fact: In a post of March 2024 its author says he started the LMPS Record Information Management System (LMPS_RIMS) himself in 2019 and has built it alone in stages with minimal resources, as a vision for crime-trend analysis and safe keeping of criminal records, and commenters ask whether he has pitched it to the authorities; no deployment in the police service is stated.
title: Lesotho Mounted Police Service Record Information Management System ( LMPS_RIMS)
